item.title: AMC Theatres Sees 5.5 Million Moviegoers During Final Weekend of 2025
item.description: AMC Entertainment (NYSE: AMC), today announced that its final weekend of 2025 was among the busiest of the year. More than 5.5 million moviegoers watched a film at AMC Theatres and ODEON Cinemas globally from Thursday, December 25, through Sunday, December 28, marking AMC Entertainment’s second-busiest Thursday-through-Sunday weekend of 2025 worldwide.
